title: edit always replaces; there is no way to append

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`ops.edit_section` assigns the body. With `--file` or `--stdin` you always replace, so
adding a line to a section non-interactively means reading it back with `show --json`,
concatenating, and writing the whole thing. The `$EDITOR` path pre-seeds the buffer, so
the ergonomic affordance exists interactively and nowhere else.

Appending is what an agent does most: record what it found, add a failing test to the
list, note a decision.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: src/slicer/cli.py, src/slicer/ops.py, tests/test_edit.py, and CLI/user documentation.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: Cover append through --text, --file and --stdin; newline boundaries; empty input; empty and missing sections; missing/conflicting sources; JSON output; logging; and --render. Preserve replacement and editor behavior.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Add `slicer edit ID --section NAME --append` with exactly one of --text, --file or --stdin. Reject missing or conflicting sources with exit 2 and code usage. Extend ops.edit_section with keyword-only append=False. Strip trailing newline characters from the old body and leading newline characters from the new body, then join nonempty bodies with two newlines. Preserve other whitespace and existing source-reading behavior. Empty appended content leaves state and log unchanged. Fill empty or missing sections without a leading separator. Keep the existing response shape and edit log action.

**Not in this slice:** prose append or editing several sections in one call.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Run focused edit tests, the full unittest suite, slicer check and git diff --check. Review code, documentation, tracking state and generated output together before marking done.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Commit reviewed S17 changes as `S17: support appending to slice sections`. Push main to origin/main, including the existing S55 documentation commit, as authorized by the owner. Never force-push.
